qualification.package: Clean public wheel/sdist and 115 focused CPU checks; version/admission/CLI checks; unprivileged image imports, matching visible source and default pipeline CLI verified. Images reuse immutable 0.8.0 dependencies and install the selected wheel offline. No model weights are bundled.
qualification.engine: Six same-GPU complete requests on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server with application-owned FP8 loaders, original two-step repaint and explicit 44 sparse / 6 dense attention. Direct RGB, selected-frame VAE decoding and exact encoder clip reuse preserved all 120 final RGB frames and source PCM in three matched pairs across two scenes. The package version change after the qualified algorithm revision changes no inference implementation.
qualification.limits: Public images have CPU/dependency/CLI verification, not a new GPU image matrix. Explicit RGB arrays may be partial and are not directly playable movies. Savings depend on repeated inputs and unused output spans; broader shapes, devices and perceptual quality are not newly qualified. Application restoration models, mask ownership, final audio composition and deployment remain separate. Zero dense-edge layers remain unsupported.
